messages:
marta_fin: FYI, customer ACCT-7482 flagged that promo credits didn't get applied to their Dedicated commit invoice (INV-2026-045). They're seeing a $12.3k overage they expected to be covered. Can we triage?
jamal_ops: which credits are they supposed to have applied? promo or contract credits?
anya_billing: looks like this account had both. promo pool 2026-Q2-ACCT7482 (expires 2026-05-31) + contract credit DC-756. I pulled the invoice, it shows line items for dedicated-commit usage but credits = $0.
marta_fin: exact lines: 
```
Product: redwood-dedicated commit (eu-west1)
Usage: 480k token-hours
Amount: $18,450.00
Promo Credit Applied: $0.00
Contract Credit Applied: $0.00
Invoice total: $12,300.00 (after other discounts)
```
jamal_ops: ops-bot, can you surface the credit-apply job logs for that run day (2026-05-01)?
ops-bot: credit-applier v2 run for 2026-05-01 completed with status FAILED. Error snippet: 
```
ERROR: CreditMapper: unknown billing_class 'dedicated_commit' for account ACCT-7482
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/credit-applier/app.py", line 412, in apply_credits
    mapper = get_mapper(billing_class)
  File "/srv/credit-applier/mappers.py", line 58, in get_mapper
    raise KeyError(billing_class)
KeyError: 'dedicated_commit'
```
leo_eng: that looks like a mapping mismatch introduced in the deploy on 2026-04-30. We added a new billing token for reserved pools and didn't update credit-applier's mapping table.
anya_billing: so credits existed but job skipped applying them because of KeyError. Can we safely re-run for the date range (2026-05-01 to 2026-05-03) and retro-apply?
jamal_ops: should be safe; two caveats: 1) need idempotency so we don't double-apply, 2) ensure promos don't cross-expiry windows. The promo expired 2026-05-31 but that still covers May invoices.
priyanka_sales: customer wants a timeline and credit note they can show their finance team. Can we commit to a timeline?
marta_fin: please create a retro credit entry if re-run succeeds. We should also notify customer and attach a provisional credit memo.
leo_eng: I'll patch the mapper to include 'dedicated_commit' -> 'dedicated' mapping and bump the credit-applier to v2.1. Patch diff small, will run unit tests, deploy in staging first. ETA 2 hours.
ops-bot: deployment queued: credit-applier v2.1 -> staging (canary). Run plan scheduled at 2026-05-02T15:40Z.
anya_billing: once v2.1 is in staging and a manual run succeeds, I will replay the job for ACCT-7482 for invoice window 2026-05-01..2026-05-03 and create retro credit entries with reason 'auto-apply bug'. I'll attach ledger IDs here.
jamal_ops: also please re-run reconciliation against cloud billing (GCP) tag: `billing_product=redwood-dedicated` to confirm line matching. Use command: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILL_KEY" "https://internal-billing.redwood/v1/reconcile?acct=ACCT-7482&from=2026-05-01&to=2026-05-03&product=redwood-dedicated" | jq '.matches | length'
```
marta_fin: add a customer-facing note: "We're applying a retro credit for a billing system issue; you will see a credit memo within 48 hours."
priyanka_sales: I'll send that wording to the customer and ask them to hold off on payment for INV-2026-045 until credit posts.
ops-bot: credit-applier v2.1 deployed to staging and manual run succeeded for sample accounts. No exceptions for 'dedicated_commit'.
anya_billing: replay started for ACCT-7482. Creating retro credits now. Ledger entries: LEDGER-2026-ACCT7482-RC1 (pending), LEDGER-2026-ACCT7482-RC2 (pending).
leo_eng: raising a small follow-up: add a unit test to prevent regressions for new billing_class tokens. I'll open ENG-PR-879 and tag billing/ops.
marta_fin: great. next steps / owners: leo_eng patch + deploy (leo), ops replay + reconcile (jamal + anya), customer comms (priyanka). Please update FIN-3421 with each step.
priyanka_sales: ping once retro credit posts and I'll confirm with the customer.
anya_billing: retro credits posted and applied to INV-2026-045. Final invoice balance reduced to $0. Customer notified. Ledger IDs finalized: LEDGER-2026-ACCT7482-RC1, LEDGER-2026-ACCT7482-RC2.
marta_fin: thanks all :tada: Marking FIN-3421 resolved, closing thread.
priyanka_sales: customer replied: "thanks — we see the credit and all good on our side." :white_check_mark:
